description: Les données de comptages pour les voies cyclables - Département du Calvados is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département du Calvados. Jeu de données listant les données de comptages des voies vélos dans le Calvados. Un site de comptage peut être équipé d'un compteur dans le cas d'un aménagement cyclable unidirectionnel ou de deux compteurs dans le cas d'un aménagement cyclable bi-directionnel. Coverage: Département du Calvados. The publisher named on the listing is Département du Calvados. Its keywords include velo, comptage. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-02-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
